pysploit.name: PYsploit
pysploit.subtitle: Automating attacks and tests with Python
pysploit.desc: Learn Python from scratch and become a developer of cybersecurity tools. In this course, you will learn how to create vulnerability scanners, exploits, and scripts for network attacks. By the end, you will have your own toolkit
pysploit.full_desc: PYsploit — a practical course on developing tools for security testing and automation of hacking using Python. Students will learn the basics of the language, creating scripts for vulnerability scanning, writing exploits, working with network protocols and APIs. Special focus is given to real-world cases: from port scanning to creating mini frameworks for penetration tests.
pysploit.course_aim: Course goal — to teach students to use Python as the primary tool for ethical hacking and cybersecurity, to write their own utilities, and adapt ready-made solutions for company or pentesting needs.

cybersecurity.name: Ethical Hacking
cybersecurity.subtitle: Learn to think like a hacker - act like a defender
cybersecurity.desc: Discover how hackers think and learn to use this knowledge for good. Hands-on training in penetration testing, vulnerability analysis, and system protection will help you become a cybersecurity professional.
cybersecurity.full_desc: Ethical Hacking — a unique opportunity to dive into the world of professional ethical hacking and penetration testing. Students learn the full cycle of secure system testing: from information gathering and vulnerability analysis to exploitation, privilege escalation, and working with secured networks. The course is hands-on: real lab assignments and scenarios, closely simulating real-world conditions, allow students to hone their skills in a safe environment. The result of the course is conducting a full penetration test and creating a professional report, making graduates ready for Red Team work and highly sought-after cybersecurity professionals.
cybersecurity.course_aim: Course goal — after completing the course, you will be able to understand attack types and defense methods, work with penetration testing tools, conduct penetration tests with reports, and build security strategies for projects and companies.

soc-analytics.name: SOC-analytics
soc-analytics.subtitle: Monitoring, analysis, and response to cyber threats
soc-analytics.desc: The SOC-analytics course explains how a Security Operations Center (SOC) works. Students dive into log analysis, event monitoring via SIEM systems, detecting suspicious activity, incident response, and working according to SOC Tier 1–2 standards. Practical exercises include analyzing real attacks and simulating phishing, DDoS, and malware incidents.
soc-analytics.full_desc: SOC-analytics — a course about how a Security Operations Center (SOC) functions. Students learn log analysis, SIEM event monitoring, detection of suspicious activity, incident response, and SOC Tier 1–2 standards. The training is practice-based: analyzing real attacks and simulating phishing, DDoS, and malware incidents helps develop reproducible, hands-on experience.
soc-analytics.course_aim: Course goal — to train entry-level and mid-level specialists capable of working in SOC, detecting cyber threats in real time, and ensuring continuous protection of a company's infrastructure.

cooperative-courses.subtitle: Customized programs tailored to your company's needs
cooperative-courses.desc: Personalized training programs designed to meet your company’s goals. Schedule a consultation, and we’ll offer a solution that fits your needs perfectly.
cooperative-courses.full_desc: Corporate Courses are personalized training programs for companies that want to enhance their team’s cybersecurity skills. The content is tailored to your specific needs — from basic employee training (data protection, password management, phishing awareness) to advanced programs for IT departments (pentesting, incident response, DevSecOps). cooperative-courses.course_aim: Course aim — to provide companies with customized cybersecurity training aligned with their business processes and real-world threats, enhancing employee awareness and reducing data breach risks.

forensics.name: Forensics (Digital Forensics)
forensics.subtitle: Uncover digital crimes and trace cyberattacks
forensics.desc: The Forensics course is a practice-oriented program in digital forensics and incident investigation. Through real cases, you will learn how to properly collect and preserve digital evidence (chain of custody), recover deleted data, build event timelines, analyze disk images and memory dumps, examine network traffic, and prepare reports for business and legal teams.
forensics.full_desc: Forensics Course — a hands-on program focused on digital forensics and cybersecurity incident response. Using real-world examples, you will learn how to properly handle and preserve digital evidence (chain of custody), recover deleted files, reconstruct event timelines, analyze disk and memory images, inspect network traffic, and present findings in professional reports for business or legal use.
forensics.course_aim: Course aim — to teach students how to use Python as a key tool in ethical hacking and cybersecurity, develop custom utilities, and adapt existing tools for company or pentest tasks.
